TITLE: Project Sankonen Update and Organizational Highlights

TO: All Employees  
FROM: Executive Leadership Team  
DATE: April 4, 2025  
SUBJECT: Project Sankonen Update and Organizational Highlights  

Zastama Industries is entering a pivotal phase in several key initiatives, and it is important that all employees remain informed about the progress and priorities shaping our work across the organization. As part of our ongoing commitment to transparency and collaboration, we are sharing updates on Project Sankonen and highlighting contributions from several team members who have played a central role in our recent achievements.

Project Sankonen, which has an approved budget of $8.4M, is currently in its second phase. The initiative continues to align with our strategic goals of enhancing operational efficiency and integrating advanced analytical tools across our fleet systems. This project is being managed with close oversight from the finance lead and the operations team, and progress is being evaluated in regular coordination with the engineering leadership. As part of our structured review process, updates are being shared with stakeholders weekly, and the next major milestone is scheduled for completion in the second quarter of 2025. We are confident that the deliverables from this project will significantly enhance our real-time monitoring and decision-making capabilities.

Nerpia Sironel has been instrumental in the technical development of Project Sankonen, particularly in the area of fleet telemetry. Since joining Zastama Industries in 2021, Nerpia has brought a wealth of expertise and has been a key driver in the integration of new data models and sensor technologies. Nerpia’s work has directly contributed to the project’s ability to generate actionable insights, and we are grateful for their ongoing dedication and innovation.

On the leadership front, we continue to see strong collaboration between our senior managers. Dretho Stopasel, who reports to Pezuor Sarlenen, has been focused on streamlining communication between departments and ensuring alignment on cross-functional objectives. Their efforts have helped to reduce bottlenecks and accelerate the implementation of several process improvements. Similarly, Krodaor Thaborine, who reports to Toperel Brirdoan, has been working closely with the logistics team to optimize supply chain operations, with a particular emphasis on inventory forecasting and distribution efficiency.

Fakra Sermus, based at the Thamhuor Campus, has also been a valuable contributor to recent advancements. Fakra’s team has been working on infrastructure upgrades that support the broader goals of Project Sankonen and other cross-departmental initiatives. Their work underscores the importance of our physical and digital infrastructure in enabling seamless operations and scalability.

We encourage all employees to continue engaging with their colleagues and to remain proactive in identifying opportunities for innovation and improvement. As we move forward with the next stage of Project Sankonen and other priorities, your input and collaboration are essential to our success. Please feel free to reach out to your team leads or your direct reports for more specific updates or to discuss how your role contributes to our shared objectives.

Thank you for your continued commitment to excellence and teamwork. We look forward to achieving even greater results in the months ahead.
